description: OpenPowerNet provides traction power-supply and train-performance simulation with electrical co-simulation through OpenTrack. The provider is Institut fur Bahntechnik GmbH, Dresden. Geographical and temporal coverage: Institut fur Bahntechnik describes commercial licences since 2009, academic licences since 2010 and current version 1.17.0. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is commercial or academic licence. The provider offers it commercially; the price is not recorded here. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. model-opentrack names the coupling to OpenPowerNet but does not describe its separate traction-power licence or electrical solver. This draft documents that distinct product.
